verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical, and both share the same flaws. The Inkwell & Lantern logo has shrunk to an unreadable stamp jammed into the card's top-left corner, so the brand is effectively lost. The '24 HOURS' eyebrow sits right of the headline's centre axis, so the two don't align. The fine print is tiny and floats beside the CTA, and the card has a dead band at the bottom. B wins only marginally: its body copy wraps more evenly ('stay as / long as you like') than A's ragged 'stay / as long as', and its book sits slightly higher, leaving more room above the card.
